units.zh: 梁書卷第五十五 列傳第四十九
units.en: Book of Liang, Volume 55, Biography 49
units.literal: Book of Liang, Volume 55, Biography 49

units.zh: 豫章王綜 武陵王紀 臨賀王正德 河東王譽
units.en: Prince Xiao Zong of Yuzhang; Prince Xiao Ji of Wuling; Prince Zhengde of Linhe; Prince Yu of Hedong
units.literal: Prince Xiao Zong of Yuzhang; Prince Xiao Ji of Wuling; Prince Zhengde of Linhe; Prince Yu of Hedong

units.zh: 豫章王綜字世謙，高祖第二子也。
units.en: Prince Xiao Zong of Yuzhang, styled Shiqian, was Gaozu's second son.
units.literal: Prince Xiao Zong of Yuzhang, styled Shiqian, was Gaozu's second son.

units.zh: 天監三年，封豫章郡王，邑二千戶。
units.en: In the third year of Tianjian he was enfeoffed as Prince of Yuzhang commandery, fief of two thousand households.
units.literal: In the third year of Tianjian he was enfeoffed as Prince of Yuzhang commandery, fief of two thousand households.

units.zh: 五年，出爲使持節、都督南徐州諸軍事、仁威將軍、南徐州刺史，尋進號北中郎將。
units.en: In the fifth year he went out as bearer of the staff, commander of South Xuzhou military affairs, General of Benevolent Might, and inspector of South Xuzhou; soon he was advanced to North Central General.
units.literal: In the fifth year he went out as Bearer of the Staff with discretionary powers, Commander of all military affairs of South Xuzhou, General of Benevolent Might, and Inspector of South Xuzhou; soon he was advanced to North Central General.

units.zh: 十年，遷都督郢、司、霍三州諸軍事、雲麾將軍、郢州刺史。
units.en: In the tenth year he was transferred to commander of E, Si, and Huo military affairs, Cloud Command General, and inspector of E.
units.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to Commander of military affairs of E, Si, and Huo provinces, Cloud Command General, and Inspector of E.

units.zh: 十三年，遷安右將軍、領石頭戍軍事。
units.en: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to Secure Right General, overseeing Stone Fort garrison affairs.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to Secure Right General, overseeing Stone Fort garrison affairs.

units.zh: 十五年，遷西中郎將，兼護軍將軍，又遷安前將軍、丹陽尹。
units.en: In the fifteenth year he was transferred to Western Central General, concurrently Protector General, then to Secure Front General and governor of Danyang.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year he was transferred to Western Central General, concurrently Protector General, then to Secure Front General and Governor of Danyang.

units.zh: 十六年，復爲北中郎將、南徐州刺史。
units.en: In the sixteenth year he again became North Central General and inspector of South Xuzhou.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year he again became North Central General and Inspector of South Xuzhou.

units.zh: 普通二年，入爲侍中、鎮右將軍，置佐史。
units.en: In the second year of Putong he entered court as Attendant-in-Ordinary and Secure Right General, with staff officers appointed.
units.literal: In the second year of Putong he entered court as Attendant-in-Ordinary and Secure Right General, with staff officers appointed.

units.zh: 初，其母吳淑媛自齊東昏宮得幸於高祖，七月而生綜，宮中多疑之者。
units.en: At first his mother Lady Wu Shuyuan, favored by Gaozu after leaving the palace of Qi Emperor Dong Hun, gave birth to Zong in the seventh month; many in the palace doubted him.
units.literal: At first his mother Lady Wu Shuyuan, favored by Gaozu after leaving the palace of Qi Emperor Dong Hun, gave birth to Zong in the seventh month; many in the palace doubted him.

units.zh: 及淑媛寵衰怨望，遂陳疑似之說，故綜懷之。
units.en: When Shuyuan's favor waned and she nursed resentment, she put forward the suspicion—and so Zong harbored it.
units.literal: When Shuyuan's favor waned and she nursed resentment, she put forward the suspicion—and so Zong harbored it.

units.zh: 旣長，有才學，善屬文。
units.en: When grown he had talent in learning and skill in literary composition.
units.literal: When grown he had talent in learning and skill in literary composition.

units.zh: 高祖御諸子以禮，朝見不甚數，綜恒怨不見知。
units.en: Gaozu governed his sons by ritual propriety and summoned them to court infrequently; Zong constantly resented that he was not recognized.
units.literal: Gaozu governed his sons by ritual propriety and summoned them to court infrequently; Zong constantly resented that he was not recognized.

units.zh: 每出籓，淑媛恒隨之鎮。
units.en: Whenever he went out to a fief, Shuyuan always accompanied him to his post.
units.literal: Whenever he went out to a fief, Shuyuan always accompanied him to his post.

units.zh: 至年十五六，尚躶袒嬉戲於前，晝夜無別，內外咸有穢議。
units.en: By fifteen or sixteen he still played naked before her, day and night undistinguished—inside and outside there was filthy talk.
units.literal: By fifteen or sixteen he still played naked before her, day and night undistinguished—inside and outside there was filthy talk.

units.zh: 綜在徐州，政刑酷暴。
units.en: When Zong was in Xuzhou, his government and punishments were cruel and violent.
units.literal: When Zong was in Xuzhou, his government and punishments were cruel and violent.

units.zh: 又有勇力，手制奔馬。
units.en: He also had courage and strength, and could by hand subdue a galloping horse.
units.literal: He also had courage and strength, and could by hand subdue a galloping horse.

units.zh: 常微行夜出，無有期度。
units.en: He often went out in disguise at night, without any fixed schedule.
units.literal: He often went out in disguise at night, without any fixed schedule.

units.zh: 每高祖有敕疏至，輒忿恚形於顏色，羣臣莫敢言者。
units.en: Whenever Gaozu's edicts or letters arrived, rage showed on his face; no minister dared speak.
units.literal: Whenever Gaozu's edicts or letters arrived, rage showed on his face; no minister dared speak.

units.zh: 恒於別室祠齊氏七廟，又微服至曲阿拜齊明帝陵。
units.en: He constantly worshipped the Qi line's seven ancestral temples in a separate chamber, and in plain dress went to Qu'e to pay respects at Emperor Ming of Qi's tomb.
units.literal: He constantly worshipped the Qi line's seven ancestral temples in a separate chamber, and in plain dress went to Qu'e to pay respects at Emperor Ming of Qi's tomb.

units.zh: 然猶無以自信，聞俗說以生者血瀝死者骨，滲，卽爲父子。
units.en: Yet he still could not trust himself; he heard a folk saying that if living blood dripped on a dead man's bone and seeped in, they were father and son.
units.literal: Yet he still could not trust himself; he heard a folk saying that if living blood dripped on a dead man's bone and seeped in, they were father and son.

units.zh: 綜乃私發齊東昏墓，出骨，瀝臂血試之。
units.en: Zong then privately opened the tomb of Dong Hun of Qi, took out the bone, and dripped blood from his arm to test it.
units.literal: Zong then privately opened the tomb of Dong Hun of Qi, took out the bone, and dripped blood from his arm to test it.

units.zh: 幷殺一男，取其骨試之，皆有驗，自此常懷異志。
units.en: He also killed a boy and tested with his bone—the results all matched; from then he constantly harbored disloyal intent.
units.literal: He also killed a boy and tested with his bone—the results all matched; from then he constantly harbored disloyal intent.

units.zh: 四年，出爲使持節、都督南兗兗徐青冀五州諸軍事、平北將軍、南兗州刺史，給鼓吹一部。
units.en: In the fourth year he went out as bearer of the staff, commander of South Yan, Yan, Xu, Qing, and Ji military affairs, Pacification North General, and inspector of South Yan, granted one suite of martial music.
units.literal: In the fourth year he went out as Bearer of the Staff, Commander of military affairs of South Yan, Yan, Xu, Qing, and Ji provinces, Pacification North General, and Inspector of South Yan, granted one suite of martial music.

units.zh: 聞齊建安王蕭寶寅在魏，遂使人入北與之相知，謂爲叔父，許舉鎮歸之。
units.en: Hearing that Xiao Baoyin, Prince of Jian'an of Qi, was in Wei, he sent men north to establish contact, called him uncle, and promised to raise his post in surrender to him.
units.literal: Hearing that Xiao Baoyin, Prince of Jian'an of Qi, was in Wei, he sent men north to establish contact, called him uncle, and promised to raise his post in surrender to him.

units.zh: 會大舉北伐。
units.en: It happened that a great northern campaign was mounted.
units.literal: It happened that a great northern campaign was mounted.

units.zh: 六年，魏將元法僧以彭城降，高祖乃令綜都督衆軍，鎮于彭城，與魏將安豊王元延明相持。
units.en: In the sixth year, Wei general Yuan Faseng surrendered Pengcheng; Gaozu then had Zong command the armies, garrison at Pengcheng, and stand off against Wei general Prince Yuan Yanming of Anfeng.
units.literal: In the sixth year, Wei general Yuan Faseng surrendered Pengcheng; Gaozu then had Zong command the armies, garrison at Pengcheng, and stand off against Wei general Prince Yuan Yanming of Anfeng.

units.zh: 高祖以連兵旣久，慮有釁生，敕綜退軍。
units.en: Gaozu, because the campaign had dragged on, feared trouble would arise and ordered Zong to withdraw the army.
units.literal: Gaozu, because the campaign had dragged on, feared trouble would arise and ordered Zong to withdraw the army.

units.zh: 綜懼南歸則無因復與寶寅相見，乃與數騎夜奔于延明，魏以爲侍中、太尉、高平公、丹陽王，邑七千戶，錢三百萬，布絹三千匹，雜彩千匹，馬五十匹，羊五百口，奴婢一百人。
units.en: Zong feared that returning south would leave him no chance to see Baoyin again; with several horsemen he fled by night to Yanming. Wei made him Attendant-in-Ordinary, Grand Commandant, Duke of Gaoping, Prince of Danyang, fief of seven thousand households, three million cash, three thousand bolts of cloth and silk, one thousand bolts of mixed brocade, fifty horses, five hundred sheep, and a hundred male and female servants.
units.literal: Zong feared that returning south would leave him no chance to see Baoyin again; with several horsemen he fled by night to Yanming. Wei made him Attendant-in-Ordinary, Grand Commandant, Duke of Gaoping, Prince of Danyang, fief of seven thousand households, three million cash, three thousand bolts of cloth and silk, one thousand bolts of mixed brocade, fifty horses, five hundred sheep, and a hundred male and female servants.

units.zh: 綜乃改名纘，字德文，追爲齊東昏服斬衰。
units.en: Zong then changed his name to Zuan, styled Dewen, and went into the one-year mourning hemp for Dong Hun of Qi.
units.literal: Zong then changed his name to Zuan, styled Dewen, and went into the one-year mourning hemp for Dong Hun of Qi.

units.zh: 於是有司奏削爵土，絕屬籍，改其姓爲悖氏。
units.en: Thereupon the relevant offices memorialized to strip his rank and fief, cut him from the genealogical register, and change his surname to the Bo clan.
units.literal: Thereupon the relevant offices memorialized to strip his rank and fief, cut him from the genealogical register, and change his surname to the Bo clan.

units.zh: 俄有詔復之，封其子直爲永新侯，邑千戶。
units.en: Soon an edict restored him; his son Zhi was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yongxin, fief of a thousand households.
units.literal: Soon an edict restored him; his son Zhi was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yongxin, fief of a thousand households.

units.zh: 大通二年，蕭寶寅在魏據長安反，綜自洛陽北遁，將赴之，爲津吏所執，魏人殺之，時年四十九。
units.en: In the second year of Datong, Xiao Baoyin held Chang'an in rebellion within Wei; Zuan fled north from Luoyang intending to join him, was seized by the ferry clerk, and the Wei people killed him—aged forty-nine.
units.literal: In the second year of Datong, Xiao Baoyin held Chang'an in rebellion within Wei; Zuan fled north from Luoyang intending to join him, was seized by the ferry clerk, and the Wei people killed him—aged forty-nine.

units.zh: 初，綜旣不得志，嘗作《聽鐘鳴》、《悲落葉》辭，以申其志。
units.en: Earlier, when Zong had not realized his ambitions, he composed the lyrics "Listening to the Bell" and "Grieving Fallen Leaves" to express his intent.
units.literal: Earlier, when Zong had not realized his ambitions, he composed the lyrics "Listening to the Bell" and "Grieving Fallen Leaves" to express his intent.

units.zh: 大略曰：
units.en: The gist runs:
units.literal: The gist runs:

units.zh: 聽鐘鳴，當知在帝城。
units.en: Listening to the bell toll—you know you are in the imperial city.
units.literal: Listening to the bell toll—you know you are in the imperial city.

units.zh: 參差定難數，歷亂百愁生。
units.en: The uneven strikes are hard to count; layer upon layer, a hundred sorrows rise.
units.literal: The uneven strikes are hard to count; layer upon layer, a hundred sorrows rise.

units.zh: 去聲懸窈窕，來響急徘徊。
units.en: The departing note hangs delicate and far; the returning sound hurries and wavers.
units.literal: The departing note hangs delicate and far; the returning sound hurries and wavers.

units.zh: 誰憐傳漏子，辛苦建章臺。
units.en: Who pities the night-watch drummer, toiling at Jianzhang Terrace?
units.literal: Who pities the night-watch drummer, toiling at Jianzhang Terrace?

units.zh: 聽鐘鳴，聽聽非一所。
units.en: Listening to the bell—listening everywhere, never in one place alone.
units.literal: Listening to the bell—listening everywhere, never in one place alone.

units.zh: 懷瑾握瑜空擲去，攀松折桂誰相許？
units.en: Jade held in the bosom, gems in the hand—cast aside to nothing; who will grant you pine-climbing and cassia-gathering?
units.literal: Jade held in the bosom, gems in the hand—cast aside to nothing; who will grant you pine-climbing and cassia-gathering?

units.zh: 昔朋舊愛各東西，譬如落葉不更齊。
units.en: Old friends and loves scattered east and west, like fallen leaves that never align again.
units.literal: Old friends and loves scattered east and west, like fallen leaves that never align again.

units.zh: 漂漂孤雁何所棲，依依別鶴夜半啼。
units.en: Where shall the drifting lone goose find rest? The parting crane calls plaintively at midnight.
units.literal: Where shall the drifting lone goose find rest? The parting crane calls plaintively at midnight.

units.zh: 聽鐘鳴，聽此何窮極？
units.en: Listening to the bell—when will this listening end?
units.literal: Listening to the bell—when will this listening end?

units.zh: 二十有餘年，淹留在京域。
units.en: Twenty-some years detained in the capital realm.
units.literal: Twenty-some years detained in the capital realm.

units.zh: 窺明鏡，罷容色，雲悲海思徒掩抑。
units.en: Peering into the bright mirror, abandoning one's looks—cloud-sorrow and sea-longing can only be buried and suppressed.
units.literal: Peering into the bright mirror, abandoning one's looks—cloud-sorrow and sea-longing can only be buried and suppressed.

units.zh: 其《悲落葉》云：
units.en: His "Grieving Fallen Leaves" reads:
units.literal: His "Grieving Fallen Leaves" reads:

units.zh: 悲落葉，連翩下重疊。
units.en: Grieving fallen leaves—fluttering down in layered drifts.
units.literal: Grieving fallen leaves—fluttering down in layered drifts.

units.zh: 落且飛，縱橫去不歸。
units.en: Falling yet flying, scattered every way, never returning.
units.literal: Falling yet flying, scattered every way, never returning.

units.zh: 悲落葉，落葉悲。
units.en: Grieving fallen leaves—fallen leaves grieve.
units.literal: Grieving fallen leaves—fallen leaves grieve.

units.zh: 人生譬如此，零落不可持。
units.en: Human life is like this—scattered, nothing to hold.
units.literal: Human life is like this—scattered, nothing to hold.

units.zh: 悲落葉，落葉何時還？
units.en: Grieving fallen leaves—when will the leaves return?
units.literal: Grieving fallen leaves—when will the leaves return?

units.zh: 夙昔共根本，無復一相關。
units.en: Once sharing the same root—no longer linked at all.
units.literal: Once sharing the same root—no longer linked at all.

units.zh: 當時見者莫不悲之。
units.en: Those who saw them at the time all grieved.
units.literal: Those who saw them at the time all grieved.

units.zh: 武陵王紀字世詢，高祖第八子也。
units.en: Prince Xiao Ji of Wuling, styled Shixun, was Gaozu's eighth son.
units.literal: Prince Xiao Ji of Wuling, styled Shixun, was Gaozu's eighth son.

units.zh: 少勤學，有文才，屬辭不好輕華，甚有骨氣。
units.en: In youth he studied diligently; he had literary talent, disliked frivolous ornament in composition, and possessed considerable backbone.
units.literal: In youth he studied diligently; he had literary talent, disliked frivolous ornament in composition, and possessed considerable backbone.

units.zh: 天監十三年，封爲武陵郡王，邑二千戶。
units.en: In the thirteenth year of Tianjian he was enfeoffed as Prince of Wuling commandery, fief of two thousand households.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year of Tianjian he was enfeoffed as Prince of Wuling commandery, fief of two thousand households.

units.zh: 歷位寧遠將軍、琅邪彭城二郡太守、輕車將軍、丹陽尹。
units.en: He held in succession General Who Calms the Distance, administrator of the two commanderies Langye and Pengcheng, Light Chariot General, and governor of Danyang.
units.literal: He held in succession General Who Calms the Distance, Administrator of the two commanderies Langye and Pengcheng, Light Chariot General, and Governor of Danyang.

units.zh: 出爲會稽太守，尋以其郡爲東揚州，仍爲刺史，加使持節、東中郎將。
units.en: He went out as administrator of Kuaiji; soon that commandery became East Yangzhou, and he remained as inspector, additionally bearer of the staff and East Central General.
units.literal: He went out as Administrator of Kuaiji; soon that commandery became East Yangzhou, and he remained as Inspector, additionally Bearer of the Staff and East Central General.

units.zh: 徵爲侍中，領石頭戍軍事。
units.en: He was summoned as Attendant-in-Ordinary, overseeing Stone Fort garrison affairs.
units.literal: He was summoned as Attendant-in-Ordinary, overseeing Stone Fort garrison affairs.

units.zh: 出爲宣惠將軍、江州刺史。
units.en: He went out as Propagation and Grace General and inspector of Jiangzhou.
units.literal: He went out as Propagation and Grace General and Inspector of Jiangzhou.

units.zh: 徵爲使持節、宣惠將軍、都督揚南徐二州諸軍事、揚州刺史。
units.en: He was summoned as bearer of the staff, Propagation and Grace General, commander of Yang and South Xu military affairs, and inspector of Yangzhou.
units.literal: He was summoned as Bearer of the Staff, Propagation and Grace General, Commander of military affairs of Yang and South Xu provinces, and Inspector of Yangzhou.

units.zh: 尋改授持節、都督益梁等十三州諸軍事、安西將軍、益州刺史，加鼓吹一部。
units.en: Soon he was reassigned bearer of the staff, commander of Yi, Liang, and eleven other provinces, Pacification West General, and inspector of Yizhou, granted one suite of martial music.
units.literal: Soon he was reassigned Bearer of the Staff, Commander of military affairs of Yi, Liang, and eleven other provinces, Pacification West General, and Inspector of Yizhou, granted one suite of martial music.

units.zh: 大同十一年，授散騎常侍、征西大將軍、開府儀同三司。
units.en: In the eleventh year of Datong he was granted Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Scattered Cavalry, Great General Who Conquers the West, and the privilege of establishing a separate office with ceremonial honors equal to the Three Dukes.
units.literal: In the eleventh year of Datong he was granted Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Scattered Cavalry, Great General Who Conquers the West, and [the right of] opening an office with ceremony equal to the Three Dukes.

units.zh: 初，天監中，震太陽門，成字曰「紹宗梁位唯武王」，解者以爲武王者，武陵王也，於是朝野屬意焉。
units.en: At first, in the Tianjian era, the Sun Gate was struck by earthquake; a sign formed that read, "To continue the Liang throne, only the Martial Prince." Interpreters held that "Martial Prince" meant the Prince of Wuling, and court and commoners looked to him.
units.literal: At first, in the Tianjian era, the Sun Gate was struck by earthquake; a sign read "The Liang throne belongs only to the Prince of Wu"—interpreters held that the Prince of Wu meant Prince Ji of Wuling, and court and commoners looked to him.

units.zh: 及太清中，侯景亂，紀不赴援。
units.en: During the Taiqing era, when Hou Jing rebelled, Ji did not come to the rescue.
units.literal: During the Taiqing era, when Hou Jing rebelled, Ji did not come to the rescue.

units.zh: 高祖崩後，紀乃僭號於蜀，改年曰天正。
units.en: After Gaozu died, Ji seized imperial title in Shu, changing the era name to Tianzheng.
units.literal: After Gaozu died, Ji seized imperial title in Shu, changing the era name to Tianzheng.

units.zh: 立子圓照爲皇太子，圓正爲西陽王，圓滿竟陵王，圓普南譙王，圓肅宜都王。
units.en: He made his son Yuanzhao crown prince, Yuanzheng Prince of Xiyang, Yuanman Prince of Jingling, Yuanpu Prince of Nanqiao, and Yuansu Prince of Yidu.
units.literal: He made his son Yuanzhao crown prince, Yuanzheng Prince of Xiyang, Yuanman Prince of Jingling, Yuanpu Prince of Nanqiao, and Yuansu Prince of Yidu.

units.zh: 以巴西、梓潼二郡太守永豊侯撝征西大將軍、益州刺史，封秦郡王。
units.en: Marquis Huo of Yongfeng, administrator of Baxi and Zitong, was appointed Great General Who Conquers the West and inspector of Yizhou, enfeoffed as Prince of Qin commandery.
units.literal: Marquis Huo of Yongfeng, Administrator of Baxi and Zitong, was appointed Great General Who Conquers the West and Inspector of Yizhou, enfeoffed as Prince of Qin commandery.

units.zh: 司馬王僧略、直兵參軍徐怦並固諫，紀以爲貳於己，皆殺之。
units.en: Master of Affairs Wang Senglue and Direct Service Army Officer Xu Ping both remonstrated firmly; Ji took this as disloyalty and had both killed.
units.literal: Master of Affairs Wang Senglue and Direct Service Army Officer Xu Ping both remonstrated firmly; Ji took this as disloyalty and had both killed.

units.zh: 永豊侯撝歎曰：「王不免矣！
units.en: Marquis Huo of Yongfeng sighed, "The prince is doomed!
units.literal: Marquis Huo of Yongfeng sighed: "The prince is doomed!

units.zh: 夫善人、國之基也，今反誅之，不亡何待！」
units.en: good men are the foundation of a state; now he kills them—how can it not perish!"
units.literal: Good men are the foundation of a state; now he kills them—how can it not perish!"

units.zh: 又謂所親曰：「昔桓玄年號大亨，識者謂之『二月了』，而玄之敗實在仲春。
units.en: he also told his intimates, "In the past Huan Xuan took the era name Daheng; interpreters called it 'the second month is done,' and his defeat indeed came in the second month.
units.literal: He also told his intimates: "In the past Huan Xuan took the era name Daheng; interpreters called it 'the second month is done,' and his defeat indeed came in the second month.

units.zh: 今年曰天正，在文爲『一止』，其能久乎？」
units.en: this year is called Tianzheng—in writing it is 'one stop'—how long can it last?"
units.literal: This year is called Tianzheng—in writing it is 'one stop'—how long can it last?"

units.zh: 太清五年夏四月，紀帥軍東下至巴郡，以討侯景爲名，將圖荊陝。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer in the fifth year of Taiqing, Ji led his army east to Ba commandery, claiming to attack Hou Jing but intending to seize Jing and Shan.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer in the fifth year of Taiqing, Ji led his army east to Ba commandery, claiming to attack Hou Jing but intending to seize Jing and Shan.

units.zh: 聞西魏侵蜀，遣其將南梁州刺史譙淹迴軍赴援。
units.en: Hearing Western Wei invade Shu, he sent his general Qiao Yan, inspector of Southern Liangzhou, to turn the army back for relief.
units.literal: Hearing Western Wei invade Shu, he sent his general Qiao Yan, Inspector of Southern Liangzhou, to turn the army back for relief.

units.zh: 五月日，西魏將尉遲迥帥衆逼涪水，潼州刺史楊乾運以城降之，迥分軍據守，卽趨成都。
units.en: On the fifth month day, Western Wei general Yuchi Tong led troops to press the Fu River; Tongzhou inspector Yang Qianyun surrendered the city, and Tong divided his forces to hold it and rushed straight for Chengdu.
units.literal: On the fifth month day, Western Wei general Yuchi Tong led troops to press the Fu River; Tongzhou Inspector Yang Qianyun surrendered the city, and Tong divided his forces to hold it and rushed straight for Chengdu.

units.zh: 丁丑，紀次于西陵，舳艫翳川，旌甲曜日，軍容甚盛。
units.en: On day dingchou, Ji halted at Xiling; warships crowded the river, banners and armor dazzled the sun—the army's appearance was very grand.
units.literal: On day dingchou, Ji halted at Xiling; warships crowded the river, banners and armor dazzled the sun—the army's appearance was very grand.

units.zh: 世祖命護軍將軍陸法和於硤口夾岸築二壘，鎮江以斷之。
units.en: Shizu ordered Protector General Lu Fahe to build two ramparts on both banks at the Gorge Mouth to hold the river and block him.
units.literal: Shizu ordered Protector General Lu Fahe to build two ramparts on both banks at the Gorge Mouth to hold the river and block him.

units.zh: 時陸納未平，蜀軍復逼，物情恇擾，世祖憂焉。
units.en: At the time Lu Na was not yet pacified and the Shu army pressed again; public sentiment was alarmed and Shizu worried.
units.literal: At the time Lu Na was not yet pacified and the Shu army pressed again; public sentiment was alarmed and Shizu worried.

units.zh: 法和告急，旬日相繼。
units.en: Lu Fahe's urgent reports came one after another for ten days.
units.literal: Lu Fahe's urgent reports came one after another for ten days.

units.zh: 世祖乃拔任約於獄，以爲晉安王司馬，撤禁兵以配之；
units.en: Shizu then pulled Ren Yue from prison and made him Master of Affairs to Prince Jin'an, assigning palace guard troops to him;
units.literal: Shizu then pulled Ren Yue from prison and made him Master of Affairs to Prince Jin'an, assigning palace guard troops to him;

units.zh: 幷遣宣猛將軍劉棻共約西赴。
units.en: and also sent Fierce Attack General Liu Fen to go west with Yue.
units.literal: and also sent Fierce Attack General Liu Fen to go west with Yue.

units.zh: 六月，紀築連城，攻絕鐵鏁。
units.en: In the sixth month, Ji built linked ramparts and attacked, severing the iron chains.
units.literal: In the sixth month, Ji built linked ramparts and attacked, severing the iron chains.

units.zh: 世祖復於獄拔謝答仁爲步兵校尉，配衆一旅，上赴法和。
units.en: Shizu again pulled Xie Daren from prison and made him Colonel of Footsoldiers, assigning him a brigade to go up and relieve Lu Fahe.
units.literal: Shizu again pulled Xie Daren from prison and made him Colonel of Footsoldiers, assigning him a brigade to go up and relieve Lu Fahe.

units.zh: 世祖與紀書曰：「皇帝敬問假黃鉞太尉武陵王：自九黎侵軼，三苗寇擾，天長喪亂，獯醜馮陵，虔劉象魏，黍離王室。
units.en: Shizu wrote Ji a letter: "The Emperor respectfully inquires of the Acting Holder of the Yellow Battle-Axe, Grand Commandant, Prince of Wuling: Since the Nine Li raided our borders and the Three Miao harassed us, Heaven long abandoned order, barbarians pressed against the capital, devoutly laid waste to the realm, and the royal house knew the sorrows of millet and thorn—
units.literal: Shizu wrote Ji a letter: "The Emperor respectfully inquires of the Acting Holder of the Yellow Battle-Axe, Grand Commandant, Prince of Wuling: Since the Nine Li raided our borders and the Three Miao harassed us, Heaven long abandoned order, barbarians pressed against the capital, devoutly laid waste to the realm, and the royal house knew the sorrows of millet and thorn—

units.zh: 朕枕戈東望，泣血西浮，殞愛子於二方，無諸侯之八百，身被屬甲，手貫流矢。
units.en: I sleep with my spear at my pillow looking east, weeping blood as I float west; I lost my beloved sons in two directions, without the eight hundred feudal lords; I wore armor myself and pierced flowing arrows with my hand.
units.literal: I sleep with my spear at my pillow looking east, weeping blood as I float west; I lost my beloved sons in two directions, without the eight hundred feudal lords; I wore armor myself and pierced flowing arrows with my hand.

units.zh: 俄而風樹之酷，萬恨始纏，霜露之悲，百憂繼集，扣心飲膽，志不圖全。
units.en: suddenly the cruelty of wind and tree came—ten thousand hates first entwined; frost and dew griefs piled on by the hundred; I beat my heart and swallowed gall, my will no longer to preserve myself whole.
units.literal: Suddenly the cruelty of wind and tree came—ten thousand hates first entwined; frost and dew griefs piled on by the hundred; I beat my heart and swallowed gall, my will no longer to preserve myself whole.

units.zh: 直以宗社綴旒，鯨鯢未剪，嘗膽待旦，龔行天罰，獨運四聰，坐揮八柄。
units.en: only because the altar and temple hang by a thread, the whale and crocodile are not yet cut down, I tasted gall awaiting dawn, marched Heaven's punishment, alone wielded the four keen ears, sat and commanded the eight handles.
units.literal: Only because the altar and temple hang by a thread, the whale and crocodile are not yet cut down, I tasted gall awaiting dawn, marched Heaven's punishment, alone wielded the four keen ears, sat and commanded the eight handles.

units.zh: 雖復結壇待將，褰帷納士，拒赤壁之兵，無謀於魯肅；
units.en: though again I raised an altar awaiting generals, lifted the curtain to welcome scholars, and repelled the Red Cliffs army—without Lu Su's counsel;
units.literal: Though again I raised an altar awaiting generals, lifted the curtain to welcome scholars, and repelled the Red Cliffs army—without Lu Su's counsel;

units.zh: 燒烏巢之米，不訪於荀攸；
units.en: burned the grain at Wuchao—without consulting Xun You;
units.literal: burned the grain at Wuchao—without consulting Xun You;

units.zh: 才智將殫，金貝殆竭，傍無寸助，險阻備嘗。
units.en: talent and wisdom nearly spent, gold and shell nearly exhausted, not a fingerbreadth of aid beside me, dangers and hardships all tasted.
units.literal: talent and wisdom nearly spent, gold and shell nearly exhausted, not a fingerbreadth of aid beside me, dangers and hardships all tasted.

units.zh: 遂得斬長狄於駒門，挫蚩尤於楓木。
units.en: yet I was able to behead the long Di at Jumen and humble Chiyou at Maplewood.
units.literal: Yet I was able to behead the long Di at Jumen and humble Chiyou at Maplewood.

units.zh: 怨恥旣雪，天下無塵，經營四方，專資一力，方與岳牧，同茲清靜。
units.en: shame and grievance now washed, the realm without dust; I manage the four directions, relying on one strength alone; I shall with the peaks and pastors share this clarity and quiet.
units.literal: Shame and grievance now washed, the realm without dust; I manage the four directions, relying on one strength alone; I shall with the peaks and pastors share this clarity and quiet.

units.zh: 隆暑炎赫，弟比何如？
units.en: in this fierce summer heat, how fares my younger brother?
units.literal: In this fierce summer heat, how fares my younger brother?

units.zh: 文武具僚，當有勞弊。
units.en: civil and military officials must be worn and weary.
units.literal: Civil and military officials must be worn and weary.

units.zh: 今遣散騎常侍、光州刺史鄭安忠，指宣往懷。」
units.en: now I send Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Scattered Cavalry and inspector of Guangzhou Zheng Anzhong to declare this and carry my embrace."
units.literal: Now I send Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Scattered Cavalry and Inspector of Guangzhou Zheng Anzhong to declare this and carry my embrace."

units.zh: 仍令喻意於紀，許其還蜀，專制岷方。
units.en: he still had him convey his intent to Ji, promising his return to Shu and sole rule over Minfang.
units.literal: He still had him convey his intent to Ji, promising his return to Shu and sole rule over Minfang.

units.zh: 紀不從命，報書如家人禮。
units.en: Ji refused and replied as between kin.
units.literal: Ji would not obey and replied in the manner of family correspondence.

units.zh: 庚申，紀將侯叡率衆緣山將規進取，任約、謝答仁與戰，破之。
units.en: On gengshen day, Ji's general Hou Rui led men along the ridges to push forward; Ren Yue and Xie Daren met them in battle and broke them.
units.literal: On gengshen day, Ji's general Hou Rui led troops along the mountains intending to advance and seize ground; Ren Yue and Xie Daren fought them and defeated them.

units.zh: 旣而陸納平，諸軍並西赴，世祖又與紀書曰：「甚苦大智！
units.en: Soon Lu Na was subdued and every army marched west; Emperor Yuan wrote again to Ji: "How you must suffer, Great Wisdom!
units.literal: Shortly afterward Lu Na was pacified; all armies advanced west together, and Emperor Yuan again wrote to Ji: "Great hardship, Great Wisdom!

units.zh: 季月煩暑，流金爍石，聚蚊成雷，封狐千里，以茲玉體，辛苦行陣。
units.en: Late summer scorches until metal runs and stone glows; mosquitoes swarm like thunder and foxes haunt the hills for a thousand li—yet you wear this royal frame through the camps.
units.literal: Late-season oppressive heat, flowing gold and burning stone, gathered mosquitoes becoming thunder, foxes in abundance for a thousand li—with this jade body, hard labor in the battle lines.

units.zh: 乃眷西顧，我勞如何？
units.en: I look west and wonder—what toll has this taken on me?
units.literal: Turning my gaze west, what is my weariness?

units.zh: 自獯醜憑陵，羯胡叛換，吾年爲一日之長，屬有平亂之功，膺此樂推，事歸當璧。
units.en: Since the northern scourge overran the land and the Jie turned traitor, I am the elder by a day and was given the work of quelling chaos—heaven's choice fell to me, and the jade scepter is mine to hold.
units.literal: Since the Xiongnu scoundrels overran the realm and the Jie barbarians rebelled and defected, I am a day older in years, and fate gave me the merit of pacifying disorder—bearing this willing elevation, the matter belongs to the one who should receive the jade disk.

units.zh: 儻遣使乎，良所遲也。
units.en: If you would send envoys, that is what I have waited for.
units.literal: If you would send envoys, that is what I have long awaited.

units.zh: 如曰不然，於此投筆。
units.en: If not, I set down my brush here and say no more.
units.literal: If you say otherwise, I lay down my brush here.

units.zh: 友于兄弟，分形共氣。
units.en: Brothers should be friends—one body, one breath.
units.literal: Brotherly affection among brothers, shared form and common breath.

units.zh: 兄肥弟瘦，無復相代之期；
units.en: One brother grows stout while the other wastes away—we shall never take turns again;
units.literal: The elder brother fat, the younger thin—no more season of taking turns;

units.zh: 讓棗推梨，長罷歡愉之日。
units.en: No more yielding jujubes or pushing pears—the days of shared delight are gone.
units.literal: Yielding jujubes and pushing pears—forever ended days of joy.

units.zh: 上林靜拱，聞四鳥之哀鳴；
units.en: In Shanglin I sit in stillness and hear four birds cry in mourning;
units.literal: In Shanglin Park, quietly seated, hearing the mournful cries of four birds;

units.zh: 宣室披圖，嗟萬始之長逝。
units.en: In the Xuan Chamber I unroll the maps and grieve that our Founder's life has long fled.
units.literal: In the Xuan Chamber unrolling the scrolls, sighing at the Founder's long departure.

units.zh: 心乎愛矣，書不盡言。」
units.en: My heart is full of love, yet ink cannot say it all."
units.literal: The heart loves indeed—the letter cannot exhaust the words."

units.zh: 大智，紀之別字也。
units.en: "Great Wisdom" was Ji's courtesy name.
units.literal: Great Wisdom was Ji's alternate style.

units.zh: 紀遣所署度支尚書樂奉業至于江陵，論和緝之計，依前旨還蜀。
units.en: Ji sent his Minister of Revenue Le Fengye to Jiangling to negotiate peace and return to Shu on the old terms.
units.literal: Ji sent his appointed Minister of Revenue Le Fengye to Jiangling to discuss plans for reconciliation, intending to return to Shu according to the earlier terms.

units.zh: 世祖知紀必破，遂拒而不許。
units.en: Emperor Yuan knew Ji was doomed and refused outright.
units.literal: Emperor Yuan knew Ji would surely be defeated, and so refused and would not agree.

units.zh: 丙戌，巴興民苻昇、徐子初等斬紀硤口城主公孫晃，降于衆軍。
units.en: On bingxu day, Fu Sheng and Xu Zichu of Baxiing cut down Xiakou commander Gongsun Huang and surrendered to the host.
units.literal: On bingxu day, the people of Baxiing Fu Sheng, Xu Zichu, and others beheaded Ji's Xiakou garrison commander Gongsun Huang and surrendered to the allied armies.

units.zh: 王琳、宋簉、任約、謝答仁等因進攻侯叡，陷其三壘，於是兩岸十餘城遂俱降。
units.en: Wang Lin, Song Zao, Ren Yue, and Xie Daren pressed Hou Rui, took his three ramparts, and more than ten cities on both shores submitted at once.
units.literal: Wang Lin, Song Zao, Ren Yue, Xie Daren, and others then advanced against Hou Rui, captured his three forts, and more than ten cities on both banks then all surrendered.

units.zh: 將軍樊猛獲紀及其第三子圓滿，俱殺之於硤口，時年四十六。
units.en: General Fan Meng seized Ji and his third son Yuanman and killed them both at Xiakou; Ji was forty-six.
units.literal: General Fan Meng captured Ji and his third son Yuanman, and both were killed at Xiakou—aged forty-six.

units.zh: 有司奏請絕其屬籍，世祖許之，賜姓饕餮氏。
units.en: The court memorialized to strike him from the clan register; Emperor Yuan assented and gave the surname Taotie.
units.literal: The relevant offices memorialized requesting severance from the clan register; Emperor Yuan granted it and bestowed the surname Taotie.

units.zh: 初，紀將僭號，妖怪非一。
units.en: When Ji first planned to take the throne, omens multiplied.
units.literal: At first, when Ji was about to usurp the title, portents were not one alone.

units.zh: 其最異者，內寢柏殿柱繞節生花，其莖四十有六，靃靡可愛，狀似荷花。
units.en: Strangest of all, in the Cypress Hall's inner chamber the pillars put forth flowers at every joint—forty-six stems, soft and lovely as lotus blooms.
units.literal: The strangest: in the inner chamber of the Cypress Hall, nodes around pillar joints sprouted flowers—forty-six stems, luxuriant and lovely, shaped like lotus blossoms.

units.zh: 識者曰：「王敦杖花，非佳事也。」
units.en: Men versed in such things said, "When Wang Dun's staff bloomed, it foretold ruin."
units.literal: Those who understood said: "When Wang Dun's staff flowered, it was no good sign."

units.zh: 紀年號天正，與蕭棟暗合，僉曰「天」字「二人」也，「正」字「一止」也。
units.en: Ji's reign era was Tianzheng, echoing Xiao Dong's in secret; people read tian as "two men" and zheng as "one halt."
units.literal: Ji's era name was Tianzheng, covertly matching Xiao Dong's; all said the character tian means "two men," and zheng means "one stop."

units.zh: 棟、紀僭號，各一年而滅。
units.en: Dong and Ji each reigned a single year before they perished.
units.literal: Dong and Ji each usurped titles for one year and were destroyed.

units.zh: 臨賀王正德字公和，臨川靖惠王第三子也。
units.en: Prince of Linhe Zhengde, styled Gonghe, was the third son of Prince Jinghui of Linchuan.
units.literal: Prince of Linhe Zhengde, styled Gonghe, was the third son of Prince Jinghui of Linchuan.

units.zh: 少粗險，不拘禮節。
units.en: As a youth he was rough and reckless and cared nothing for propriety.
units.literal: In youth he was coarse and dangerous, not bound by ritual propriety.

units.zh: 初，高祖未有男，養之爲子。
units.en: Early on, before Gaozu had a son of his own, he adopted Zhengde.
units.literal: At first, when Gaozu had no sons, he adopted him as a son.

units.zh: 及高祖踐極，便希儲貳，後立昭明太子，封正德爲西豊侯，邑五百戶。
units.en: Once Gaozu took the throne, Zhengde coveted the heirship; when the Zhaoming Heir Apparent was named, Zhengde received only the marquisate of Xifeng—five hundred households.
units.literal: When Gaozu ascended the throne, Zhengde at once hoped for the heirship; later when the Zhaoming Heir Apparent was established, Zhengde was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xifeng with five hundred households.

units.zh: 自此怨望，恒懷不軌，䁹睨宮扆，覬幸災變。
units.en: Thereafter he brooded on slights, plotted treason, eyed the palace throne, and prayed for disaster.
units.literal: From then he nursed resentment, constantly harboring rebellious intent, casting sidelong glances at the palace throne, hoping for calamity and change.

units.zh: 普通六年，以黃門侍郎爲輕車將軍，置佐史。
units.en: In the sixth year of Putong he rose from Gentleman at the Yellow Gate to General of Light Chariots with a staff.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Putong, as Gentleman in Attendance at the Yellow Gate he became General of Light Chariots with a staff.

units.zh: 頃之，遂逃奔于魏，有司奏削封爵。
units.en: Soon he fled to Wei; the court moved to strip his rank and fief.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he fled to Wei; the relevant offices memorialized to strip his titles and fiefs.

units.zh: 七年，又自魏逃歸，高祖不之過也。
units.en: In the seventh year he slipped back from Wei; Gaozu let the matter pass.
units.literal: In the seventh year he again fled back from Wei; Gaozu did not punish him.

units.zh: 復其封爵，仍除征虜將軍。
units.en: His honors were restored and he was made General Who Pacifies the Barbarians.
units.literal: His titles and fiefs were restored, and he was additionally made General Who Pacifies the Barbarians.

units.zh: 中大通四年，爲信武將軍、吳郡太守。
units.en: In the fourth year of Zhongdatong he served as Trustworthy Martial General and administrator of Wu commandery.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Zhongdatong he was Trustworthy Martial General and Administrator of Wu commandery.

units.zh: 徵爲侍中、撫軍將軍，置佐史，封臨賀郡王，邑二千戶，又加左衛將軍。
units.en: He was recalled as Attendant-in-Ordinary and General Who Pacifies the Army, enfeoffed Prince of Linhe with two thousand households, and made Left Guard General besides.
units.literal: He was summoned as Attendant-in-Ordinary, General Who Pacifies the Army with staff, enfeoffed as Prince of Linhe commandery with two thousand households, and additionally made Left Guard General.

units.zh: 而凶暴日甚，招聚亡命。
units.en: His cruelty deepened by the day as he gathered fugitives and desperate men.
units.literal: Yet his ferocity and violence grew daily worse; he gathered fugitives and outlaws.

units.zh: 侯景知其有姦心，乃密令誘說，厚相要結。
units.en: Hou Jing sensed his treachery and secretly wooed him with lavish pledges.
units.literal: Hou Jing knew he had treacherous intent and secretly sent men to entice and persuade him, binding him with rich promises.

units.zh: 遺正德書曰：「今天子年尊，姦臣亂國，憲章錯謬，政令顛倒，以景觀之，計日必敗。
units.en: He wrote to Zhengde: "The Son of Heaven is old, corrupt ministers ruin the realm, law and order are upside down—in my reading, collapse comes within days.
units.literal: He sent Zhengde a letter: "Today the Son of Heaven is aged, wicked ministers disorder the state, statutes err and edicts overturn—from Jing's view, defeat is counted in days.

units.zh: 況大王屬當儲貳，中被廢辱，天下義士，竊所痛心，在景愚忠，能無忿慨？
units.en: You were born to the succession yet cast aside in shame—righteous men everywhere ache at it; can even my blunt loyalty stay cold?
units.literal: Moreover the Great King by lineage should be heir, mid-course cast down in disgrace—the world's men of righteousness all secretly grieve; can Jing's dull loyalty fail to burn with indignation?

units.zh: 今四海業業，歸心大王，大王豈得顧此私情，棄茲億兆！
units.en: The realm trembles and hearts turn to you—will you choose private feeling over a hundred million lives?
units.literal: Now the four seas tremble in fear and hearts turn to the Great King—can the Great King cling to private feeling and abandon these hundred millions!

units.zh: 景雖不武，實思自奮。
units.en: I am no soldier, yet I mean to fight.
units.literal: Though Jing is no warrior, he truly means to rouse himself.

units.zh: 願王允副蒼生，鑒斯誠款。」
units.en: Grant my plea, serve the people, and read this as honest intent."
units.literal: May the King grant this and match the people's need—discern this sincere pledge."

units.zh: 正德覽書大喜曰：「侯景意暗與我同，此天贊也。」
units.en: Zhengde read it and exulted: "Hou Jing thinks as I do—Heaven is with us."
units.literal: Zhengde read the letter and rejoiced greatly: "Hou Jing's intent secretly matches mine—Heaven approves."

units.zh: 遂許之。
units.en: He agreed.
units.literal: He then agreed.

units.zh: 及景至江，正德潛運空舫，詐稱迎荻，以濟景焉。
units.en: When Jing reached the river, Zhengde sent empty boats under the pretense of collecting reeds and ferried him across.
units.literal: When Jing reached the Yangtze, Zhengde secretly dispatched empty boats, falsely claiming to gather reeds, to ferry Jing across.

units.zh: 朝廷未知其謀，猶遣正德守朱雀航。
units.en: The court still knew nothing of the plot and sent Zhengde to hold the Zhuque crossing.
units.literal: The court did not yet know his plot and still sent Zhengde to guard the Zhuque Bridge crossing.

units.zh: 景至，正德乃引軍與景俱進，景推正德爲天子，改年爲正平元年，景爲丞相。
units.en: Jing came; Zhengde opened the gates and marched with him. Jing proclaimed Zhengde emperor, named the era Zhengping year one, and took the chancellorship himself.
units.literal: When Jing arrived, Zhengde led his army to advance with Jing; Jing set up Zhengde as Son of Heaven, changed the era to Zhengping year one, and made himself Chancellor.

units.zh: 臺城沒，復太清之號，降正德爲大司馬。
units.en: When the palace city fell, the Taiqing era was restored and Zhengde was reduced to Grand Marshal.
units.literal: When the capital fortress fell, the Taiqing era name was restored and Zhengde was demoted to Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 正德有怨言，景聞之，慮其爲變，矯詔殺之。
units.en: Zhengde grumbled; Jing, fearing betrayal, forged an edict and had him killed.
units.literal: Zhengde had resentful words; Jing heard and, fearing he might turn, forged an edict and killed him.

units.zh: 河東王譽字重孫，昭明太子第二子也。
units.en: Prince of Hedong Yu, styled Chongsun, was the second son of the Zhaoming Heir Apparent.
units.literal: Prince of Hedong Yu, styled Chongsun, was the Zhaoming Heir Apparent's second son.

units.zh: 普通二年，封枝江縣公。
units.en: In the second year of Putong he was made Duke of Zhijiang county.
units.literal: In the second year of Putong he was enfeoffed as Duke of Zhijiang county.

units.zh: 中大通三年，改封河東郡王，邑二千戶。
units.en: In the third year of Zhongdatong he was re-enfeoffed Prince of Hedong commandery with two thousand households.
units.literal: In the third year of Zhongdatong his fief was changed to Prince of Hedong commandery with two thousand households.

units.zh: 除寧遠將軍、石頭戍軍事。
units.en: He was appointed General of Distant Peace and put in charge of the Shitou garrison.
units.literal: He was made General of Distant Peace and charged with the garrison affairs at Shitou.

units.zh: 出爲琅邪、彭城二郡太守。
units.en: He went out to govern Langye and Pengcheng commanderies.
units.literal: He went out as Administrator of the two commanderies Langye and Pengcheng.

units.zh: 還除侍中、輕車將軍，置佐史。
units.en: On return he became Attendant-in-Ordinary and General of Light Chariots with a staff.
units.literal: Returning he was made Attendant-in-Ordinary, General of Light Chariots with staff.

units.zh: 出爲南中郎將、湘州刺史。
units.en: He went out as General of the Southern Center and inspector of Xiangzhou.
units.literal: He went out as General of the Southern Center and Inspector of Xiangzhou.

units.zh: 未幾，侯景寇京邑，譽率軍入援，至青草湖，臺城沒，有詔班師，譽還湘鎮。
units.en: Soon Hou Jing struck the capital; Yu marched to relieve it, reached Qingcao Lake, then heard the city had fallen, received orders to withdraw, and returned to his post in Xiang.
units.literal: Before long Hou Jing raided the capital; Yu led troops to rescue, reached Qingcao Lake; the fortress fell, an edict ordered withdrawal, and Yu returned to his Xiang post.

units.zh: 時世祖軍于武城，新除雍州刺史張纘密報世祖曰：「河東起兵，岳陽聚米，共爲不逞，將襲江陵。」
units.en: Emperor Yuan was then at Wucheng; the new inspector of Yongzhou, Zhang Zuan, secretly warned him: "Hedong has risen and Yueyang is hoarding grain—they plot mischief and mean to strike Jiangling."
units.literal: At the time Emperor Yuan's army was at Wucheng; the newly appointed Inspector of Yongzhou Zhang Zuan secretly reported to Emperor Yuan: "Hedong has raised troops and Yueyang is stockpiling grain—together they are unrestrained and will strike Jiangling."

units.zh: 世祖甚懼，因步道間還，遣諮議周弘直至譽所，督其糧衆。
units.en: Emperor Yuan was terrified; he slipped back by side roads and sent Adviser Zhou Hongzhi to Yu's camp to take command of grain and troops.
units.literal: Emperor Yuan was greatly afraid; he returned by land routes, sent Adviser Zhou Hongzhi to Yu's headquarters to oversee his grain and troops.

units.zh: 譽曰：「各自軍府，何忽隸人？」
units.en: Yu said, "Each man has his own command—why suddenly place me under another?"
units.literal: Yu said: "Each has his own army headquarters—why suddenly make one subordinate to another?"

units.zh: 前後使三反，譽並不從。
units.en: Three envoys came and went; Yu refused each time.
units.literal: Envoys went back and forth three times; Yu would not obey.

units.zh: 世祖大怒，乃遣世子方等征之，反爲譽所敗死。
units.en: Enraged, Emperor Yuan sent his heir Fangdeng against him; Yu defeated and killed him.
units.literal: Emperor Yuan in great anger sent the Heir Fangdeng to campaign against him; instead Fangdeng was defeated and killed by Yu.

units.zh: 又令信州刺史鮑泉討譽，幷與書陳示禍福，許其遷善。
units.en: He then ordered Bao Quan, inspector of Xinzhou, to attack Yu, writing to show reward and ruin and offering a path to repentance.
units.literal: He again ordered Inspector of Xinzhou Bao Quan to attack Yu, and with a letter set forth fortune and disaster, promising he could turn to good.

units.zh: 譽不答，修浚城池，爲拒守之計。
units.en: Yu made no answer; he strengthened walls and moats and prepared to stand siege.
units.literal: Yu did not reply; he repaired and dredged the walls and moats, planning to resist and hold.

units.zh: 謂鮑泉曰：「敗軍之將，勢豈語勇？
units.en: He told Bao Quan, "A beaten general has no right to speak of courage.
units.literal: He said to Bao Quan: "A defeated general—where is the talk of bravery?

units.zh: 欲前卽前，無所多說。」
units.en: Advance if you will—say no more."
units.literal: If you wish to advance, advance—nothing more need be said."

units.zh: 泉軍于石槨寺，譽帥衆逆擊之，不利而還。
units.en: Quan camped at Shigu Temple; Yu led a counterattack, failed, and pulled back.
units.literal: Quan encamped at Shigu Temple; Yu led troops to strike him head-on, did not succeed and withdrew.

units.zh: 泉進軍于橘洲，譽又盡銳攻之，不剋。
units.en: Quan moved on Juzhou; Yu threw in every crack soldier and still could not break him.
units.literal: Quan advanced to Juzhou; Yu again attacked with all his elite troops and could not overcome him.

units.zh: 會已暮，士卒疲弊，泉因出擊，大敗之，斬首三千級，溺死者萬餘人。
units.en: At dusk, with Yu's men spent, Quan counterstruck and shattered them—three thousand heads taken and more than ten thousand drowned.
units.literal: When evening came the soldiers were worn and exhausted; Quan then sallied forth and routed them—three thousand heads cut, over ten thousand drowned.

units.zh: 譽於是焚長沙郭邑，驅居民於城內，鮑泉度軍圍之。
units.en: Yu burned Changsha's outer suburbs, herded the people within the walls, and Bao Quan brought his army across to invest the city.
units.literal: Yu then burned the outer walls of Changsha, drove the residents inside the city, and Bao Quan crossed the army to besiege it.

units.zh: 譽幼而驍勇，兼有膽氣，能撫循士卒，甚得衆心。
units.en: Yu had been bold since boyhood, fearless and skilled at winning soldiers' hearts.
units.literal: Yu from youth was fierce and brave, possessed daring as well; he could comfort and lead soldiers and greatly won the troops' hearts.

units.zh: 及被圍旣久，雖外內斷絕，而備守猶固。
units.en: Besieged for months, cut off within and without, he still held firm.
units.literal: Though besieged long, though inner and outer were cut off, defenses and holding remained firm.

units.zh: 後世祖又遣領軍將軍王僧辯代鮑泉攻譽，僧辯築土山以臨城內，日夕苦攻，矢石如雨，城中將士死傷者太半。
units.en: Later Shizu also sent Commandant of the Army Wang Sengbian to replace Bao Quan in attacking Yu. Sengbian raised earthworks overlooking the city and assaulted bitterly day and night until arrows and stones fell like rain and more than half the soldiers in the city were dead or wounded.
units.literal: Later Emperor Yuan again sent Commandant of the Army Wang Sengbian to replace Bao Quan in attacking Yu; Sengbian built earthen mounds overlooking the inner city, attacked bitterly day and night—arrows and stones like rain—more than half the officers and soldiers in the city were killed or wounded.

units.zh: 譽窘急，乃潛裝海船，將潰圍而出。
units.en: Desperate, Yu secretly prepared sea boats to burst the siege and flee.
units.literal: Yu in dire straits secretly fitted out sea boats, intending to break the siege and escape.

units.zh: 會其麾下將慕容華引僧辯入城，譽顧左右皆散，遂被執，謂守者曰：「勿殺我！
units.en: Then his officer Murong Hua admitted Sengbian into the city; Yu's followers scattered and he was taken. He cried to his guards, "Do not kill me!
units.literal: Just then his subordinate general Murong Hua led Sengbian into the city; Yu looked—his attendants had all scattered—he was seized, and said to his guards: "Do not kill me!

units.zh: 得一見七官，申此讒賊，死亦無恨。」
units.en: Let me see the Seventh Officer once and denounce this slanderer—then I can die without regret."
units.literal: Let me see the Seventh Officer once and expose this slanderous villain—even death would hold no regret."

units.zh: 主者曰：「奉命不許。」
units.en: The officer said, "My orders forbid it."
units.literal: The officer in charge said: "By order it is not permitted."

units.zh: 遂斬之，傳首荊鎮，世祖反其首以葬焉。
units.en: He was beheaded; the head was sent to the Jing garrison, and Emperor Yuan returned it for burial.
units.literal: He was then beheaded; the head was sent to the Jing post and Emperor Yuan returned the head for burial.

units.zh: 初，譽之將敗也，私引鏡照面，不見其頭；
units.en: Before his fall, Yu once looked in a mirror and saw himself headless;
units.literal: At first, when Yu was about to fall, he privately held up a mirror to his face and could not see his head;

units.zh: 又見長人蓋屋，兩手據地瞰其齋；
units.en: he dreamed of a giant roofing a house, hands on the ground, staring into his hall;
units.literal: he also saw a tall man roofing a house, both hands on the ground peering into his study;

units.zh: 又見白狗大如驢，從城而出，不知所在。
units.en: he also saw a white dog the size of a donkey leave the city and vanish.
units.literal: he also saw a white dog large as a donkey leaving the city—whereabouts unknown.

units.zh: 譽甚惡之，俄而城陷。
units.en: Yu loathed these signs; soon the city fell.
units.literal: Yu greatly hated these omens, and shortly the city fell.

units.zh: 史臣曰：蕭綜、蕭正德並悖逆倡狂，自致夷滅，宜矣。
units.en: The historian writes: Xiao Zong and Xiao Zhengde were rebels and madmen who destroyed themselves—no more than they deserved.
units.literal: The historian writes: Xiao Zong and Xiao Zhengde both rebelled and raved in treason, bringing extinction on themselves—as they deserved.

units.zh: 太清之寇，蕭紀據庸、蜀之資，遂不勤王赴難，申臣子之節；
units.en: In the Taiqing disaster Xiao Ji held the wealth of Yong and Shu yet never rushed to the throne's rescue or kept a son's or subject's duty;
units.literal: In the Taiqing calamity, Xiao Ji held the resources of Yong and Shu, yet did not hasten to the king's aid in crisis or fulfill a subject's and son's duty;

units.zh: 及賊景誅剪，方始起兵，師出無名，成其釁禍。
units.en: only after Hou Jing was destroyed did he march—an army without just cause, sealing his own ruin.
units.literal: only after the bandit Jing was cut down did he at last raise troops—an army setting out without cause, completing his stain of disaster.

units.zh: 嗚呼！
units.en: Alas!
units.literal: Alas!

units.zh: 身當管、蔡之罰，蓋自貽哉。
units.en: He suffered the fate of Guan and Cai—and had only himself to blame.
units.literal: Bearing punishment like Guan and Cai—he brought it on himself.

units.zh: 又從僧辯克定京邑，降謝答仁，平陸納於湘州。
units.en: He again followed Sengbian in recovering the capital, took Xie Daren's surrender, and pacified Lu Na in Xiangzhou.
units.literal: He again followed Sengbian in recovering the capital, received the surrender of Xie Daren, and pacified Lu Na in Xiangzhou.

units.zh: 見鳳專政泰重，戒之曰：「昔周公身有至聖之德，屬有叔父之親，而成王有獨見之明，無信讒之聽，然管、蔡流言而周公懼。
units.en: Seeing Wang Feng's grip on power grow oppressive, Du Qin warned him: "The Duke of Zhou was the paragon of sagehood and the king's uncle, and King Cheng was a discerning sovereign who refused slander—yet the rumor spread by Guan and Cai still struck terror into the duke.
units.literal: Seeing Feng monopolized government too heavily, he warned him, saying, "Formerly the Duke of Zhou personally had utmost sage virtue, in kinship had uncle relation, yet King Cheng had alone-seeing clarity, had no listening to slander—still Guan and Cai spread drifting words and the Duke of Zhou feared.

units.zh: 王敦唱禍于前，蘇峻肆毒於後，凶暴過於董卓，惡逆甚於傕、汜，普天率土，誰不同忿！
units.en: He catalogued Jin's domestic rebels beside Han villains.
units.literal: Wang Dun raised calamity before; Su Jun poisoned the realm after—viciousness surpassed Dong Zhuo; treason exceeded Li Jue and Guo Si—who under heaven does not share the rage!

units.zh: 因復博徵智謀之士龐紀、何顒、荀攸等，與同腹心。
units.en: He also summoned strategists such as Pang Ji, He Yong, and Xun You and took them into his inner circle.
units.literal: Therefore he again broadly summoned men of wisdom and stratagem such as Pang Ji, He Yong, and Xun You, and with them shared innermost counsel.

units.zh: 初，紀至巴郡，聞迥來侵，遣譙淹回師，為撝外援。
units.en: Earlier, when Ji reached Ba commandery and learned that Yuchi Jiong was invading, he sent Qiao Yan back with his army to reinforce Hui.
units.literal: Earlier, when Ji reached Ba commandery and heard that Jiong was coming to invade, he dispatched Qiao Yan to turn his army back as external support for Hui.

units.zh: 尉遲迥 王謙 司馬消難
units.en: Wei Chijiong (Yuchi Jiong); Wang Qian; Sima Xiaonan
units.literal: Wei Chijiong; Wang Qian; Sima Xiaonan

units.zh: 迥分遣元珍、乙弗亞等以輕騎破之，遂降。
units.en: Yuchi Jiong sent Yuan Zhen, Yifu Ya, and others with light cavalry to break them, and Qiao Yan surrendered.
units.literal: Jiong separately dispatched Yuan Zhen, Yifu Ya, and others with light cavalry to defeat him, and he thereupon surrendered.

units.zh: 父大同，輕車岳陽王記室參軍，掌京邑行選。
units.en: His father Datong was record-office aide to the Prince of Yueyang of the Light Chariots establishment and ran metropolitan appointments.
units.literal: His father Datong was record-office aide to the Prince of Yueyang, Light Chariots, and managed metropolitan selection.

units.zh: 琳亦疑禍，令長史陸納率部曲前赴湘州，身徑上江陵。
units.en: Lin also suspected disaster. He ordered chief clerk Lu Na to lead his troops ahead to Xiangzhou while he himself went straight up to Jiangling.
units.literal: Lin also suspected disaster; he ordered Chief Clerk Lu Na to lead his troops ahead to Xiangzhou while he himself went straight up to Jiangling.

units.zh: 陸納等及軍人並哭對使者，莫肯受命，乃報黃羅漢，殺張載。
units.en: Lu Na and the soldiers all wept facing the envoys and would not accept orders; they reported to Huang Luohan and killed Zhang Zai.
units.literal: Lu Na and the soldiers all wept facing the envoys and would not accept orders; they reported to Huang Luohan and killed Zhang Zai.

units.zh: 將行，謂納等曰：「吾若不返，子將安之？」
units.en: About to depart, he said to Na and the rest, "If I do not return, where will you go?"
units.literal: About to depart, he said to Na and the rest: "If I do not return, where will you go?"

units.zh: 梁元遣王僧辯討納，納等敗走長沙。
units.en: Emperor Yuan of Liang sent Wang Sengbian to attack Na; Na and the rest were defeated and fled to Changsha.
units.literal: Emperor Yuan of Liang sent Wang Sengbian to attack Na; Na and the rest were defeated and fled to Changsha.

units.zh: 載性深刻，為帝所信，荊州疾之如仇，故納等因人之欲，抽腸系馬腳，使繞而走，腸盡氣絕，又臠割備五刑而斬之。
units.en: Zai was harsh by nature and trusted by the emperor; Jingzhou hated him like an enemy. So Na and the rest, playing on men's desires, drew out his entrails and tied them to a horse's leg, making the horse run until the guts were gone and breath ended; then they carved him piecemeal through the five punishments and beheaded him.
units.literal: Zai was harsh by nature, trusted by the emperor; Jingzhou hated him like an enemy — so Na and the rest, playing on men's desires, drew out his entrails and tied them to a horse's leg, making the horse run until the guts were gone and breath ended; then they carved him piecemeal through the five punishments and beheaded him.

units.zh: 納啟申琳罪，請復本位，永為奴婢。
units.en: Na memorialized stating Lin's crimes, asking that he be restored to his original post and offering that they would be slaves forever.
units.literal: Na memorialized stating Lin's crimes, asking restoration to his original post, willing to be slaves forever.

units.zh: 納等投戈俱拜，舉軍皆哭，曰：「乞王郎入城，卽出。」
units.en: Na and the rest cast down their weapons and bowed together; the whole army wept and said, "We beg Young Master Wang enter the city — we will come out at once."
units.literal: Na and the rest cast down their weapons and bowed together; the whole army wept and said: "We beg Young Master Wang enter the city — we will come out at once."

units.zh: 及放琳入，納等乃降，湘州平。
units.en: When Lin was released and entered, Na and the rest then surrendered, and Xiangzhou was pacified.
units.literal: When Lin was released and entered, Na and the rest then surrendered, and Xiangzhou was pacified.

units.zh: 時納兵出方戰，會琳至，僧辯升諸樓車以示之。
units.en: At the time Na's troops were out fighting; when Lin arrived, Sengbian mounted the tower chariots to show him.
units.literal: At the time Na's troops were out fighting; when Lin arrived, Sengbian mounted the tower chariots to show him.

units.zh: 矯為太宗詔，禪于豫章嗣王棟，大赦改年。
units.en: He forged an abdication edict in Taizong's name to the successor prince of Yuzhang, Dong, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the reign title.
units.literal: Forging an edict in Taizong's name, he abdicated to the Successor Prince of Yuzhang, Dong; a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.

units.zh: 敬皇帝，諱方智，字慧相，小字法真，世祖第九子也。
units.en: Emperor Jing, personal name Fangzhi, style name Huixiang and childhood name Fazhen, was the ninth son of Emperor Yuan.
units.literal: Emperor Jing, personal name Fangzhi, style Huixiang, childhood name Fazhen, was the ninth son of Emperor Yuan.

units.zh: 紹泰元年冬十月己巳，詔曰：「王室不造，嬰罹禍釁，西都失守，朝廷淪覆，先帝梓宮，播越非所，王基傾弛，率土罔戴。
units.en: On jisi in the tenth month of winter, Shaotai year 1, an edict said: "The royal house is unformed, stricken with disaster; the western capital fell, the court collapsed; the late emperor's coffin wandered abroad, the throne shook, and the realm had no support.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, day jisi, year 1 of Shaotai, an edict said: "The royal house is not established, suffering calamity and misfortune; the western capital was lost, the court fell into ruin; the former emperor's coffin was cast to improper places, the royal foundation tilted and slackened, and throughout the realm none upheld [us].
